name_zh: 马泰乌斯库/罗马尼亚统一：拉丁岛屿生存与战略自主
name_en: Michael the Brave/Romanian Unification: Latin Island Survival & Strategic Autonomy
description_zh: 罗马尼亚作为东正教环境中的拉丁语族"岛屿"，历经米哈伊·维特亚祖尔 (1558-1601) 首次三省统一、1859 摩尔多瓦-瓦拉几亚合并、1918 大罗马尼亚建国、1947 共产主义/齐奥塞斯库/1989 革命/2004 北约/2007 欧盟。核心生存逻辑：拉丁身份锚定(语言/法律/文化)→大帝国夹缝(奥/俄/土/德/苏)灵活平衡→战略自主(独立外交/核不扩散/黑海能源/多瑙河航运)。体现 M170 拉丁岛屿生存——以"拉丁身份+灵活平衡+战略自主+黑海枢纽"四位一体，在斯拉夫/奥斯曼/德/苏四强夹缝中实现民族国家延续。
description_en: Romania as Latin-language 'island' in Orthodox environment, across Michael the Brave (1558-1601) first three-province union, 1859 Moldavia-Wallachia union, 1918 Greater Romania, 1947 communism/Ceausescu/1989 revolution/2004 NATO/2007 EU. Core survival logic: Latin identity anchor (language/law/culture) -> great empire interstice (Austro/Russian/Ottoman/German/Soviet) flexible balancing -> strategic autonomy (independent diplomacy/nuclear non-proliferation/Black Sea energy/Danube navigation). Exemplifies M170 Latin Island Survival—quaternity of 'Latin identity + flexible balancing + strategic autonomy + Black Sea hub' achieving nation-state continuity in Slavic/Ottoman/German/Soviet four-power squeeze.
reason_zh: 罗马尼亚生存史是"拉丁身份+灵活平衡"双螺旋：语言/法律/文化锚定西方，地理/能源/安全迫使东向平衡。米哈伊首次统一→卡罗尔一世独立→费迪南大统一→安托内斯库倒向德/米哈伊一世倒向苏→齐奥塞斯库独立外交/拒入侵捷/联中→后共欧盟/北约/黑海能源。M170 区隔于 M181 边境地带(乌克兰)、M170 部落联邦(伊拉克)、M173 哈希姆守护(约旦)，核心在于"拉丁身份锚定+大国灵活平衡+黑海战略枢纽"的拉丁岛屿生存范式。
reason_en: Romanian survival history is double helix of 'Latin identity + flexible balancing': language/law/culture anchor West, geography/energy/security force East balancing. Michael first union -> Carol I independence -> Ferdinand Great Union -> Antonescu pro-German/Michael I pro-Soviet -> Ceausescu independent diplomacy/refused Czech invasion/opened China -> post-comm EU/NATO/Black Sea energy. M170 distinct from M181 Borderland (Ukraine), M170 Tribal Federalism (Iraq), M173 Hashemite Guardian (Jordan), core: 'Latin identity anchor + great power flexible balancing + Black Sea strategic hub' Latin island survival paradigm.
steps_zh: 拉丁身份确立与坚守：达科-罗马连续性/拉丁字母/罗马法传统/西向教会，语言成民族灵魂锚定
大帝国夹缝灵活平衡：奥斯曼/奥匈/俄/德/苏/美，始终在两大阵营间寻找自主空间，从不彻底倒向单边
大统一与战略自主：1918 阿尔巴尤利亚大统一/1944 米哈伊一世倒向盟军缩短战争/1960s 齐奥塞斯库独立外交/拒入侵捷/建交中/核不扩散
黑海能源枢纽与多瑙河航运：康斯坦察港/黑海油气/多瑙河-黑海运河/三海倡议/北约东翼，地理劣势转战略资产
后共民主巩固与战略自主：1989 革命/2004 北约/2007 欧盟/黑海能源/核电/三海倡议领袖，战略自主成核心叙事
steps_en: Latin identity establishment & adherence: Daco-Roman continuity/Latin alphabet/Roman law tradition/Western church, language as ethnic soul anchor
Great empire interstice flexible balancing: Ottoman/Austro-Hungarian/Russian/German/Soviet/US, always seeking autonomy space between two blocs, never fully tilting to one side

Great Union & strategic autonomy: 1918 Alba Iulia Great Union/1944 Michael I turns to Allies shortening war/1960s Ceausescu independent diplomacy/refused Czech invasion/opened China/nuclear non-proliferation
Black Sea energy hub & Danube navigation: Constanta port/Black Sea oil-gas/Danube-Black Sea Canal/Three Seas Initiative/NATO eastern flank, geographic liability turned strategic asset
Post-comm democratic consolidation & strategic autonomy: 1989 revolution/2004 NATO/2007 EU/Black Sea energy/nuclear/Three Seas leader, strategic autonomy as core narrative
expected_zh: 以"拉丁身份+灵活平衡+战略自主+黑海枢纽"四位一体，在斯拉夫/奥斯曼/德/苏四强夹缝中实现拉丁语族民族国家延续，为夹缝生存提供拉丁岛屿范式。
expected_en: Quaternity of 'Latin identity + flexible balancing + strategic autonomy + Black Sea hub' achieves Latin nation-state continuity in Slavic/Ottoman/German/Soviet four-power squeeze, providing Latin island survival paradigm for interstice survival.
